page.subtitle: Customise your Harvests experience and manage your security and payment preferences.

security.title: Account security
security.emailResendError: Could not send the verification email. Please try again later.
security.emailText: Essential to receive your invoices and critical alerts.
security.passwordText: Change your password regularly to keep your account secure.
security.passwordTooShort: The new password must be at least 8 characters long.

export.title: Download my data
export.text: Export a copy of your personal data (profile, orders, products and reviews depending on your account type) in JSON format.

deleteAccount.title: Delete my account
deleteAccount.text: Permanent action: your personal data will be anonymised and your account deactivated. Your existing orders are kept for legal reasons.
deleteAccount.modalText: This action cannot be undone. Confirm your identity with your password or your account email to continue.

addresses.title: Delivery addresses
addresses.emptyText: Add an address to make your future purchases easier.
addresses.label: Address name
addresses.required: Name, address, city and region are required.

financial.title: Financial information
financial.emptyText: Set up your transfer details to receive your payments directly into your account.

notifications.title: Notification preferences

email.label: Email
email.description: Invoices, monthly reports and account alerts.

sms.label: SMS alerts
sms.description: Urgent notifications for deliveries in progress.

push.label: Real-time notifications
push.description: Instant alerts on your mobile devices and computers.

orderUpdates.label: Order tracking
orderUpdates.description: Every step of your orders, from farm to table.

priceAlerts.label: Price alerts
priceAlerts.description: Price changes on the products you follow.

marketing.label: Offers & newsletter
marketing.description: New producers, promo codes and Harvests news.

notifications.privacyText: Some notifications related to your account security or your transactions cannot be turned off.

push.unsupportedText: Your browser does not support push notifications. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
push.deniedTextStart: Notifications have been blocked in your browser. To turn them back on, click the padlock
push.deniedTextEnd: in the address bar → Notifications → Allow.
push.title: Mobile push notifications
push.activeText: On: you will receive alerts even when the app is closed.
push.inactiveText: Off: turn them on to receive real-time alerts on this device.
push.defaultBadge: The browser will ask for your permission when you turn them on
push.denied: Permission denied. Allow notifications in your browser settings.
push.enableError: Error while turning them on. Please try again.
push.disableError: Error while turning them off. Please try again.
